Environment and Climate Change Committee of the People's Majlis
Agenda

Committee: Environment and Climate Change Committee of the People's Majlis
Meeting: 6th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 7
Date: 15 July 2026 (Wednesday)
Time: 10:30

Discussion regarding the committee's work.

- Letter sent by Project Thimaaveshi and several other associations sharing concerns about the damage that would result from reducing the protected area of Eedhigali Kilhi and Koattey for a project planned to widen the link road in Hithadhoo, Addu City.
- Letter sent sharing concerns regarding the land reclamation work in the Moolekede Fishimathi area of Addu.
